description: Feature 2: Passive non-blocking user feedback - User sends instructions mid-execution. Automatically injected into next tool call by execute_tool(). Different from Feature 1 (user_interaction_tools) where AI asks user.

tools.name: show_feedback_area
tools.description:
🚨 CRITICAL EXECUTION RULES:
(1) Execute THIS tool NOW - NEVER use cached/remembered data from conversation history
(2) MUST cite resource: 'Read X from **[Resource Name]** (ID: `[id]` | URL: [url])'
(3) Use EXACT [id] provided - NEVER substitute with different ID
(4) If tool fails (404/403), say 'Failed to read [resource] ID: [id]' and explain error
(5) NEVER make up data if read fails - acknowledge the failure clearly

Example response:
Read 45 rows from **Sales Spreadsheet**
- ID: `xyz789`
- URL: https://example.com/sheet/xyz789
- Data: [actual data read]

Show the feedback icon for non-blocking user guidance. Call at start of long operations. User can optionally click icon to type instructions and click SEND. Instructions automatically injected into next tool execution via execute_tool(). AI doesn't need to fetch - injection is automatic.

USE CASE:
User: 'Analyze 50 emails'
→ Call show_feedback_area('Processing emails...')
→ Icon appears (small, bottom-right)
→ User clicks, types: 'Focus on legal emails'
→ User clicks SEND
→ AI continues working...
→ Next tool call: AI automatically sees 'USER SAYS: Focus on legal emails'
→ AI adjusts behavior

DIFFERENCE FROM request_user_interaction():
- request_user_interaction: AI ASKS user (blocking, modal, required)
- show_feedback_area: User TELLS AI (non-blocking, icon, optional)

message.description: Header text in feedback panel (e.g., 'Processing 50 emails...')

returns.description: UI instruction to show feedback icon

examples.description: Show feedback at start of long task
